nodes.label: Reasoning Dynamics Analysis
nodes.author: Zihao Wei, Liang Pang, et al.
nodes.rationale: Analysis of LLM overthinking through two complementary lenses: reasoning length dynamics (thinking-content compensation) and semantic dynamics (convergence patterns).

nodes.label: Reasoning Length Dynamics
nodes.rationale: Analysis revealing compensatory tradeoff between thinking and content length; shows thinking-content compensation followed by saturation where further thinking becomes redundant.

nodes.label: Thinking-Content Compensation
nodes.rationale: Phenomenon where shorter thinking forces model to offload reasoning into content to maintain performance; results in increased content length in early reasoning stages.

nodes.label: Thinking Redundancy Phase
nodes.rationale: Late-stage reasoning where content retracts to conciseness and accuracy stabilizes; further thinking expands without altering content, manifesting as pure redundancy.

nodes.label: Reasoning Semantic Dynamics
nodes.rationale: Analysis of high-dimensional semantic trajectory evolution; identifies semantic path convergence from active exploration to stable neighborhood with repetitive oscillations.

nodes.label: Semantic Exploration Phase
nodes.rationale: Initial reasoning phase where semantic representations undergo rapid shifts indicating active exploration of solution paths; exhibits high instability in induced content distribution.

nodes.label: Semantic Convergence Phase
nodes.rationale: Late reasoning phase where semantics converge toward stable neighborhood with repetitive oscillations; induced content distribution approaches terminal state.

nodes.label: Reasoning Completion Point (RCP)
nodes.rationale: Instance-specific boundary separating active reasoning from converged reasoning; defined as earliest step where both content stabilization and semantic convergence are achieved.

nodes.label: Reasoning Completion Point Detector (RCPD)
nodes.rationale: Inference-time early-exit method detecting RCP by monitoring rank dynamics of termination tokens (</think>); enables 44% token reduction while preserving accuracy.

nodes.label: Stepwise Truncation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Experimental methodology forcing model to stop thinking at controlled steps and immediately generate content; enables granular analysis of reasoning process evolution.

nodes.label: LLM Overthinking Phenomenon
nodes.rationale: Non-monotonic scaling behavior where excessive reasoning leads to diminishing returns or performance degradation; motivates need for understanding reasoning dynamics.

nodes.label: Post-RCP Confirmation Bias
nodes.rationale: Phenomenon where models overwhelmingly adopt injected intermediate answers rather than recovering correct original answers; demonstrates post-RCP generation rationalizes rather than re-verifies.

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
nodes.rationale: Technique known to enhance LLM performance across various tasks; related to reasoning trajectory analysis in RCPD work.
